title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-01-03
source: BD > MR > DAT > C > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy early‑70s show, highlighted by an inspired 'The Other One' and a fiery Black Peter.
ai_review.review: These reviews rave about both the improved sound quality of this soundboard copy and the band's electric performance. The Other One is repeatedly called out as a favorite, while Black Peter, Dancing In The Street and the Midnight Hour close receive special praise for their intensity. Overall the set captures the raw excitement of the era with clear audio that lets listeners enjoy every moment.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers gave 4‑5 stars, consistently praising the performance and noting superior sound quality; no negative comments were present.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note this copy has noticeably better clarity than other versions, with no reported drop‑outs or muffling.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A high‑energy, tightly‑gathered performance that captures the confidence of the band in early 1970, with strong transitions and memorable jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s vocals on Black Peter are praised ('Jer just sings it out'); his guitar work is implied to be solid throughout.
